title: Bowtie VarQTE: A Resource-Efficient Quantum State Preparation Primitive
summary: The preparation of quantum states is a fundamental requirement for many quantum algorithms. A native route to preparing physically structured states is based on short-time simulation of dynamical processes, such as real or imaginary time evolution. This work presents a resource-efficient framework for the approximation thereof with \textit{bowtie \ac{VarQTE}} which uses classical simulation where possible and quantum resources where necessary.
